blocks.text: Langley houses by price band, September 2026

64 houses sold in September against 449 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,250,001 to $1,500,000, with 20 sold (31% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $900,001 to $1,000,000 at 24%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: What counts as a "house" on this page?
faq.a: Detached houses in the City of Langley and the Township of Langley — one house on its own lot, at any price — with acreage and farms left off the feed by the page's own definition, though large-lot cards (a 19,000+ sq ft Salmon River estate; a 0.312-acre Campbell Valley property) appear in the visible feed, so treat the exclusion as the page's stated intent rather than a verified filter.

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Township of Langley lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units for lots of 280 m² or less, and 4 units for lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m² (1 acre); lots larger than 1 acre are not eligible, and eligibility also requires the Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation and no Transit-Oriented Area location. There is no 6-unit tier in the Township.

faq.q: How many units can a City of Langley house lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 3284 (adopted June 17, 2024), RS1 and RS2 lots permit a Plex-Home of up to 4 units, or 6 units if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — a different answer from the Township's, which is why the municipality check comes first.

faq.q: Which school district serves Langley houses, and how are catchments set?
faq.a: SD35 Langley for both municipalities; catchments are address-based. Recorded locator runs in this program exist only for 26850 29 Ave (Aldergrove), 4452 256 St (Salmon River) and 7888 200 St (Willoughby) — confirm any other address with the SD35 School Locator before relying on a school claim (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/verification/catchment-addresses-by-district.md, read 2026-11-01).
